cards.text:
V-TD11/001EN
Blue Sky Knight, Altmile
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[CONT](VC/RC):During your turn, if you have no face up cards in your damage zone, this unit gets [Power] +15000.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Discard a card from your hand], search your deck for up to two grade 2 cards, reveal them and put them into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

V-TD11/002EN
Unite Reet Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed from hand, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], and you may call a grade 2 card from your hand to (RC). If you called, draw a card.

V-TD11/003EN
Absolute Blade Knight, Livarot
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed from hand, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], search your deck for up to one grade 2 card, call it to an open (RC), and shuffle your deck. If you have no face up cards in your damage zone, you may pay "[Soul-Blast 1]" for this cost.

V-TD11/004EN
Knight of Magnificence, Lucus
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 10000
-

V-TD11/005EN
Sage of Contemplation, Tedun
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[ACT](RC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +15000 until end of turn.

V-TD11/006EN
Pioneer Knight, Epaticcus
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[CONT](RC):During the battle it attacked a vanguard, this unit gets [Power] +3000.

V-TD11/007EN
Lunar Crescent Knight, Felax
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When it attacks or boosts, [COST][Soul-Blast 1 & return a rear-guard in another column to your hand], and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle.

V-TD11/008EN
Indestructible Knight, Earina
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO](GC):When placed, [COST][discard a card from your hand], and one of your units cannot be hit until end of that battle.
[AUTO](VC):When placed, draw a card, and discard a card from your hand.

V-TD11/009EN
Melodious Angel
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 1｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 10000
[ACT](RC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 2], draw a card, and if you have no face up cards in your damage zone, [Counter-Charge 1].

Shining Knight, Millius
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO]:When rode upon, draw a card. Then, if your opponent's vanguard is grade 1 or greater, put a Quick Shield ticket into your hand.

Quick Shield
Others｜ -｜ Grade 0｜ Power -｜ Shield -
